_comment: Shipped DEFAULT **BUILD** gate. It runs DURING a phase and before anything downstream. Generic and deliberately lenient (tests and typecheck are optional so it never blocks a fresh project that has neither yet). /builder-kit:start scaffolds docs/checkpoints/checkpoint.json and build-phase scaffolds per-phase manifests that TIGHTEN these.
_split: The acceptance-criteria row is NOT here, and that is the point. It lives in checkpoint-close-manifest.json (and in docs/checkpoints/phase-<N>-close.json). A single gate that demands ticked criteria before the evidence pass has run fails by construction on every first close, and the only way through it is to tick the boxes to make it green, which inverts evidence-then-tick into tick-to-go-green. Do not add a checklist-done row to this file.
_tokens: {{PLUGIN_SCRIPTS}} expands to the directory this manifest ships in, so the gate.mjs rows below survive a plugin update. checkpoint.mjs does the substitution.
